changelog.title: ✨ Notes Grid View, Decrypting Feedback & Passphrase Generator Fixes
changes: Added 2-column Grid View and List View toggle for Notes with folder badges
Added visual loading state ('Decrypting Vault...') and spinner when unlocking the vault
Fixed wordlist import error in BIP39 passphrase generator
Added clear error alerts and retry states when checking for app updates
General performance and UI polish across account profile and vault cards
